legend: An example of breast carcinoma from a patient with germline ATM mutation demonstrates ductal morphology with lobular features including cells infiltrating singly and in strands. This tumour was ER/PR-positive and ERBB2 (HER2)-negative. The tumour does not demonstrate the high nuclear grade or brisk immune response often associated with BRCA-mutated tumours.
